subject: maths
question: TQ = 6 cm is a tangent to the circle and TPX is a secant. If TP = y cm and PX = 5 em, find y.
solution:
**Given:**

Tangent TQ = 6 cm

Secant TPX with TP = y cm, PX = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Tangent² = (External part of secant) × (Whole secant)

i.e., TQ² = TP × (TP + PX)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae6c07ecba5810065f4bb9319e084ba28874
81afdbb8630efd3eddd72af930df.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 6² = y × (y + 5)

⇒ 36 = y² + 5y

⇒ y² + 5y − 36 = 0

⇒ y² + 9y − 4y − 36 = 0

⇒ y(y + 9) − 4(y + 9) = 0

⇒ (y − 4)(y + 9) = 0

⇒ y = 4 (reject −9 as length cannot be negative)

**∴ TP = y = 4 cm.**
